definitions.primary: 32 closed-loop clients, fixed N; exact S1 W4 tail; 3 repetitions of 1s warmup/4s measurement
definitions.long: 32 clients, paced open-loop at 4525/s A or 2262/s B; 10s/20s, 3 repetitions; latency includes intended-time dispatch backlog; client_service_ms starts at client admission
definitions.reported: median rate/mean/p50 across repetitions; maximum repetition p99; syncs weighted by batch count; CPU median whole-trial logical CPUs, not physical cores
